query:
UPDATE mail_smtp_settings
            SET
                host = $3,
                port = $4,
                username = $5,
                password_enc = $6,
                tls_mode = $7,
                from_address = $8,
                from_name = $9,
                reply_to = $10,
                sent_folder = $11,
                is_enabled = $12,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE mail_account_id = $1 AND owner_id = $2
